headline: Weathered Expanse Squares Even as Olavis Wake Flares
war_summary: Three hours after our last edition, two contested quarters have squared even. At Weathered Expanse the Wardens have ceded a post and the Colonials gained one, leaving three strongholds apiece and three in ruin after sixty-one flag actions in a day, with Spirit Watch and Frostmarch the busiest ground. Kuura Strand's demolished post has been rebuilt by Colonials, restoring an even three-to-three footing after fighting at Menneen and Faden Point. Olavis Wake, which our previous edition found flagless, now shows movement: twenty-two actions in a day at Iltaku, Kulkue, and Koskinla, the latest logged as this edition closed. Pari Peak's Colonial margin has slipped to three-to-one, one post now in ruin. Linn of Mercy's Outwich Ranch has absorbed eighteen changes without loosening the region's Colonial grip, and Nevish Line still churns around Tomb Father. Wardens took Transient Valley at Farranac Coast, the Gutter's overnight melee has stilled, and Marban Hollow stirs anew at Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall. Attrition runs heaviest at Weathered Expanse, Callahan's Passage, and Olavis Wake, with Dead Lands' casualty rate climbing steeply. This is the war's 667th day.
